name: kinetograph-migrate
description: Move an existing Remotion project onto Kinetograph so it renders without a browser. Use when the user has a Remotion project (remotion or @remotion/* imports, `remotion render` scripts, @remotion/three, @remotion/player) and wants it to run, preview or render with Kinetograph, or asks what in a Remotion project will not work there.

findings.excerpt: Run commands as `npx kinetograph <command>`. Add `--json` to get one JSON object. For the other commands and the
| `npx remotion studio <entry>` | `npx kinetograph studio <entry>` (add `--no-open` when you start it yourself; it runs until stopped) |
| `npx remotion render <entry> <id> out.mp4` | `npx kinetograph render <entry> --comp <id> -o out/renders/<id>.mp4` |
| `npx remotion still <entry> <id> out.png --frame=45` | `npx kinetograph still <entry> 45 --comp <id> -o out/stills/<id>-f45.png` |
| `@remotion/renderer` `selectComposition` + `renderMedia({ composition, inputProps })` | shell out to `kinetograph render --comp --props`, or call `npx kinetog
